dialogue.origin: (こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願い致します）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. I look forward to speaking with you today.)

dialogue.origin: （こんばんは！こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.content: (Good evening! Likewise, I look forward to speaking with you.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。年齢、性別、ご相談内容をお話ください。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm your counselor. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: こんばんは！48歳女性家族との関わりで悩んでいます。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Good evening! I'm a 48-year-old woman, and I'm struggling with my relationships with my family. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは苦しいですね。どのような関わりでお悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very difficult. What specific aspects of your interactions with your family are troubling you?

dialogue.origin: はい、コミュニケーションの取り方で悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm struggling with how we communicate.

dialogue.origin: 私以外、特に夫と娘は否定的でいちいち嫌な気分になります。
dialogue.content: Everyone else, especially my husband and daughter, is negative, and it makes me feel unpleasant at every turn.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ご主人と娘さんの3人ですね。それは嫌な気持ちになりますね。
dialogue.content: I see. So it's the three of you: you, your husband, and your daughter. That would understandably feel unpleasant.

dialogue.origin: 否定されると気持ちも落ち込んでしまうかもしれません。どのようなことで否定的になりますか？
dialogue.content: Being met with negativity can be disheartening. In what kinds of situations do they become negative?

dialogue.origin: はい。家族構成的には息子もおりますが息子は反抗期真っ只中の中学生なのである程度、母親に否定的なのは理解できます。夫や高校生の娘は以前から私を責める言葉が多い気がします。些細なことばかりの日常会話なのですが、いちいち揚げ足取りたがり、不快なコミュニケーションに嫌気がさします💦
dialogue.content: Yes. Our family also includes a son, but he's a middle schooler in the thick of his rebellious phase, so I can understand that he's somewhat negative toward his mother. My husband and high-school-aged daughter, however, have long tended to use accusatory words toward me. It's mostly in trivial, everyday conversations, but they love to nitpick, and I'm fed up with the unpleasant communication. 💦

dialogue.origin: お話頂きありがとうございます。息子さんの反抗期もありながら、些細なことで不快なコミニュケーションはイライラすることもあるかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. With your son's rebellious phase on top of everything else, this unpleasant communication over trivial matters must be very frustrating.

dialogue.origin: ご主人と娘さんはどちらが気になりますか？
dialogue.content: Which concerns you more, your husband or your daughter?

dialogue.origin: はい、本当に。。夫や娘とは離れたい…とまで思ってしまいます💦夫と娘どちらかは
dialogue.content: Yes, really... It's gotten to the point where I want to get away from my husband and daughter... 💦 As for choosing between my husband and my daughter...

dialogue.origin: 選ぶのが大変難しいのですが直近の様子では娘です。
dialogue.content: It's very difficult to choose, but based on how things have been recently, it's my daughter.

dialogue.origin: 私のさまざまな言葉が地雷になるようで、爆発を繰り返してます
dialogue.content: It seems like various things I say are landmines for her, and she keeps exploding.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それはとてもしんどいですね。ご自身も疲れてしまっているのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very tough. I imagine you're feeling exhausted yourself?

dialogue.origin: はい、心身疲れています😓
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm exhausted mentally and physically. 😓

dialogue.origin: 夜中も寝ていても不機嫌な娘に起こされます
dialogue.content: My moody daughter even wakes me up in the middle of the night.

dialogue.origin: 寝不足が続いています
dialogue.content: I've been continuously sleep-deprived.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それはとてもしんどいですし、寝れないのは余計に疲れてしまいますね。
dialogue.content: I see. That's very hard, and not being able to sleep just makes the exhaustion even worse.

dialogue.origin: はい、寝不足はキツイです
dialogue.content: Yes, the lack of sleep is really tough.

dialogue.origin: とても負担が多い状況だと思います。娘さんとのコミニュケーションでどのようなことがしんどいですか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're under a lot of strain. What about the communication with your daughter do you find most difficult?

dialogue.origin: とにかく細かいことで不機嫌になりパニックになることです。。
dialogue.content: It's that she gets moody and panics over the smallest things.

dialogue.origin: そうなると物を蹴ったり、時に投げたり叫んだり
dialogue.content: When that happens, she kicks things, sometimes throws them, and screams.

dialogue.origin: 何時だろうと構わず暴れます
dialogue.content: She'll have an outburst no matter what time it is.

dialogue.origin: 知的正常ですが自閉傾向があります。
dialogue.content: Intellectually she's normal, but she has autistic tendencies.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは気が抜けないですし、お気持ちしんどいですね。今までおひとりで抱えてこられたんですか？
dialogue.content: I see. You can never let your guard down, and that must be emotionally draining. Have you been dealing with this all by yourself until now?

dialogue.origin: 他、ADHDもグレーです
dialogue.content: She's also borderline ADHD.

dialogue.origin: パニックがあまりに酷くて病院にも通っていました。クリニックにカウンセリングも受けていましたが改善しません💦
dialogue.content: Her panic attacks were so severe that we were going to the hospital for them. She also received counseling at a clinic, but there's been no improvement. 💦

dialogue.origin: 夫や息子はもちろん状況を理解していますが、対応するのは私のみです
dialogue.content: Of course, my husband and son understand the situation, but I'm the only one who deals with her.

dialogue.origin: ほか、誰も手をつけられない、、という感じもあります💦
dialogue.content: It also feels like no one else can handle her. 💦

dialogue.origin: そうあったんですね。色々試されたり、工夫されてきたと思います。離れたいと思う気持ちは自然なことだと思います。よく頑張ってこられましたね。
dialogue.content: So that's how it's been. I imagine you've tried and devised various things. It's only natural to feel like you want to get away. You've been doing so well for so long.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます😭私の対応次第で良くなるだろうと甘えからきているとも感じるのですが、毎日の癇癪に私も理性を保つのが大変です、、
dialogue.content: Thank you. 😭 I sometimes feel it stems from her dependency—this idea that things will get better depending on how I respond—but with the daily tantrums, it's hard for me to keep my composure.

dialogue.origin: 対応なども学びながらあれこれやってますが正直嫌になッてきました
dialogue.content: I've been learning how to handle things and trying various approaches, but honestly, I'm getting fed up.

dialogue.origin: あまりに些細なことで爆発し、責められるのでもう、いいやと思ってしまう時もあります。
dialogue.content: She explodes over such trivial things and blames me, so there are times I just think, 'I'm done.'

dialogue.origin: それはそうだと思います。理性を保とうと努力されているのだと思います。感情が爆発して当然です。　今まで頑張ってきた気持ちがとてもすごいことだと思います。
dialogue.content: That makes complete sense. I can tell you're trying very hard to maintain your composure. It's natural for your emotions to explode. The fact that you've persevered for this long is truly amazing.

dialogue.origin: ギリギリのところで頑張っているかと思います。
dialogue.content: I imagine you're operating right at your limit.

dialogue.origin: 認めていただいてありがとうございます！家族からは労いもないので、虚しくなります。。
dialogue.content: Thank you for acknowledging that! I don't get any words of appreciation from my family, so it makes me feel empty.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。あなたは十分前向きに頑張っていますし、努力されています。嫌になったり、投げ出す気持ちが出ることもあります。自然なことです。
dialogue.content: I see. You are trying your best and putting in a lot of effort. It's natural to feel fed up or want to give up sometimes.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、母親なのに娘と離れたいと思う自分に冷たさも感じていました
dialogue.content: Is that so... I felt I was being cold for wanting to distance myself from my daughter, even though I'm her mother.

dialogue.origin: でも、感じても仕方ないとも思っていました
dialogue.content: But I also thought it couldn't be helped that I felt that way.

dialogue.origin: それにしても、娘や夫の理不尽な言葉、対応に振り回されないで生きたいです！
dialogue.content: Nevertheless, I want to live my life without being tossed around by my daughter’s and husband’s unreasonable words and behavior!

dialogue.origin: 家族から孤独感や虚しい気持ちになって当然です。離れたと思うほど、今は余裕がないのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: It's natural to feel lonely and empty because of your family. Wanting to get away might just mean you don't have the emotional bandwidth for it right now.

dialogue.origin: ご主人と娘さんの言葉に振り回されないようにしたいのですね。
dialogue.content: So you want to avoid being swayed by your husband's and daughter's words.

dialogue.origin: はい、余裕はないです。毎日を普通に過ごすだけで疲れます。娘や夫の言動に動じない自分になりたいです。
dialogue.content: Yes, I have no capacity left. Just getting through a normal day is exhausting. I want to become someone who isn't fazed by what my daughter and husband say and do.

dialogue.origin: はい、そう思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。目標をはっきりもって素晴らしいですね。このような状況でご自身を成長したいと思えるのは誰でもできることではありません。
dialogue.content: I agree. It's wonderful that you have such a clear goal. Not everyone can think about personal growth in a situation like this.

dialogue.origin: お優しい言葉をありがとうございます！！嬉しいです。そして目標を達成したいです。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your kind words!! That makes me happy. And I want to achieve my goal.

dialogue.origin: 何か方法を考えたいと思いますが、どのような方法が考えられますか？例えば、一人の時間を持つ、定期的にどこかに出かける等、少し離れてみる時間があればと思いますがどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I'd like us to consider some approaches. What methods come to mind for you? For example, making time for yourself, going out somewhere regularly... creating some time to get a little distance. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。日常の中で、仕事のあとカフェで時間を持ったりリフレッシュ出来るようには、これまでもして来たのですが、それではなかなか私の根本的な心の安定には繋がりませんでした💦
dialogue.content: Thank you. I have tried to do that in my daily life, like taking time to refresh at a café after work, but it hasn't really led to a fundamental sense of emotional stability for me. 💦

dialogue.origin: 帰宅すれば同様のことがすぐに繰り返されるので私の受け取り方を変えないと難しいのかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: Since the same things repeat as soon as I get home, it might be difficult unless I change the way I perceive things.

dialogue.origin: このような状況の娘もそのまま受け入れられたら娘も、改善するのかな？と思いますがなかなか難しく、、ついつい早く大人になって欲しい…等と思ってしまいます。
dialogue.content: I wonder if my daughter would improve if I could just accept her as she is in this situation, but it's very difficult... I can't help but wish she would grow up more quickly.

dialogue.origin: そうあったんですね。あなたが頑張っているのはあなた自身がよくわかっていると思います。ご自身を認めるお気持ちはあったりしますか？
dialogue.content: I see. I think you yourself know best how hard you're trying. Do you have any feelings of self-acceptance?

dialogue.origin: 我ながらこの夫と娘とよくやってるな、と思います笑
dialogue.content: I do think to myself, "I'm doing a pretty good job dealing with this husband and daughter," lol.

dialogue.origin: でも、私も改善の余地がたくさんあるんだろうとも思います💦
dialogue.content: But I also think there's a lot of room for improvement on my part. 💦

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。周りから否定的な言葉ばかりだとご自身を責める気持ちがあったりするかもしれません。改善の余地とはどのようなことができそうですか？
dialogue.content: I see. When you constantly hear negative words from those around you, you might find yourself blaming yourself. When you mention room for improvement, what kinds of things do you think you could work on?

dialogue.origin: やはり受け取り方や返す言葉など、でしょうか？つい自分が正しいと思って話してしまう癖があるようです。よく娘に指摘されます。ママが正しいんじゃなくて一般的なことって、そう思う人が多いだけでしょ、と私の考え方の人は少ないと思うけど、間違いではないとよく言っています。
dialogue.content: I suppose it's about how I perceive things and the words I use in response? I seem to have a habit of speaking as if I'm always right. My daughter points it out often. She'll say things like, "Mom, it's not that you're right, it's that your opinion is just a common one that many people happen to share. I think fewer people think the way I do, but that doesn't make my way of thinking wrong."

dialogue.origin: 私が言い返さず徹底的に聞くことが出来たら少し娘も満足するかもしれません
dialogue.content: If I could listen thoroughly without arguing back, maybe my daughter would be a bit more satisfied.

dialogue.origin: 色々と対応を考えているのですね。娘さんの言っていることを少しだけ聞いてみるところから始めてみるのはいいですね。徹底的にだと疲れてしまいますし、ママでも感情はありますので、、ひとつづつ、進んでいくのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You're thinking about various ways to handle this. Starting by just trying to listen a little to what your daughter is saying is a good idea. Trying to do it thoroughly all the time would be exhausting, and moms have feelings too. How about taking it one step at a time?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。ひとつづつ…ですね、聞くことを心がけて来たつもりでしたが、足りてないようなので今までより意識して聞くことはして行こうと思います。ママにも感情がある、本当にそうですね！！
dialogue.content: Yes, you're right. One step at a time... I thought I had been making an effort to listen, but it seems it wasn't enough, so I'll try to be more conscious of listening than before. "Moms have feelings too"—that's so true!!

dialogue.origin: そのように思えるあなたは、普段から娘さんと向き合っているからだと思います。そしてご自身が正しいと娘さんに指摘されるという言葉も受け入れていると思います。それを行動に移していける方ですし、ひとつづつ進んでいけると思います。感情が爆発するのは当然です。
dialogue.content: The fact that you can think that way shows that you consistently face your daughter. And I believe you are accepting her words when she points out that you speak as if you're always right. You are someone who can put that into action, and I believe you can move forward one step at a time. It's only natural for your emotions to explode.

dialogue.origin: 今日はここまでお話されてどう思われますか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel after our discussion today?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。一気に改善は難しいので、まずはひとつづつやって行きます！
dialogue.content: Thank you. It's difficult to improve all at once, so I'll start by taking it one step at a time!

dialogue.origin: はい、なんとなくただ嫌だ、どうしよう…という感じから脱した気がします。
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel like I've moved past that vague feeling of just, 'I hate this, what do I do...?'

dialogue.origin: たくさん認めていただけて私頑張ってるんだ！と自信も持てました✨
dialogue.content: Being acknowledged so much has given me the confidence to feel, 'I really am doing my best!' ✨

dialogue.origin: 今日はご家族とのコミニュケーションのお悩みでここに来てくれました。あなたはとても頑張っています。ひとつづつクリアしていくことで前進できると思います。このような状況で頑張っていける方なので、これからも切り開いていけると思います。もし、また行き詰ってしまった時はこちらにご相談にいらしてください。
dialogue.content: Today you came here with concerns about communication with your family. You are trying very hard. I believe you can move forward by tackling things one by one. You are someone who can persevere in a situation like this, so I'm sure you can continue to forge a path forward. If you ever feel stuck again, please don't hesitate to come back and talk with us.

dialogue.origin: 本日はお時間になりましたので、ご相談を終わりにしたい思います。よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Our time is up for today, so I'd like to conclude our session. Is that all right with you?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。お陰様で今まずは娘のことが一番課題で何をしたらよいか、出来ることは何かが分かりました！やってみます。今日は以上で大丈夫です。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. Thanks to you, I now understand that my daughter is my main priority, and I have a clearer idea of what I should do and what I can do. I'll give it a try. That's all for today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: そう思えたのですね。それはよかったです。ではご相談を終了致します。本日はお話をして頂きありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I'm glad you feel that way. That's good. In that case, I will end the session now. Thank you for speaking with me today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました！また宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well! I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.origin: （本日はありがとうございました。とても勉強になりました。評価よりアドバイスお願い致します）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time today. It was a great learning experience. I would appreciate your advice rather than a formal evaluation.)

dialogue.origin: （こちらこそありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well. Thank you for your hard work.)

dialogue.origin: （では終了アナウンス流します）
dialogue.content: (Then I'll play the closing announcement.)

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Okay!

topic.sub: 娘とのコミュニケーション問題
